claude_proposed_widenings.name: create_obscurement
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's primary non-spell effect is an area of heavy obscuration with an asymmetric exemption. No existing effect atom models area obscuration or visibility denial honestly.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The insects remain for 10 minutes, making the area Heavily Obscured for creatures other than you.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: shared_resource_activation_menu
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: One magic item exposes multiple distinct activated options that consume the same charge pool. The current activation family does not represent choosing among separate item abilities without collapsing them into one false effect bundle.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: expend 1 charge to cause a swarm ... You can cast one of the spells on the following table from it

claude_proposed_widenings.name: duration_end_trigger.dispersed_by_strong_wind
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The cloud has an explicit environmental early-end trigger that is not target-side and is not covered by the current duration-end grammar.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A strong wind (like that created by Gust of Wind) disperses the swarm and ends the effect.
